wishes.title: Shift wishes
wishes.subtitle: Enter your wishes for the next roster.
wishes.howTo: Pick a wish below, then tap the days. Tap again to remove it.
wishes.notAPromise: Wishes are not a promise. Your ward manager creates the roster and tries to consider as many wishes as possible.
wishes.deadlineText: Shift wishes for {{month}} can be submitted until {{date}}.
wishes.lockedText: Shift wishes for {{month}} are closed (deadline: {{date}}). You can view your wishes but no longer change them.
wishes.lockedAfterSubmit: Your wishes have been submitted. Your facility does not allow changes after submission.
wishes.noneSubmitted: You did not submit any wishes for this period.
wishes.generalNotePlaceholder: e.g. "No night shifts on weekends, please"
wishes.errorRules: Your wishes do not meet your ward's rules (e.g. too many days off) or the deadline has passed.
wishes.successTitle: Your shift wishes were submitted successfully.
wishes.successText: You can view your wishes at any time and change them until the deadline if your facility allows it.
wishes.noPeriodTitle: No wish period is open right now

manage.title: Shift wishes
manage.subtitle: All wishes of your wards – as input for the roster.
manage.noPeriodsHint: Create a wish period so your team can enter wishes.
manage.legend: The wish is shown on top (coloured), the planned shift below it (code, dashed = draft). Red outline = the plan contradicts the wish. A wish is never applied automatically.
manage.reviewHint: "Considered" is feedback only – you still enter the shift in the roster yourself.
manage.createHint: For one ward and one month
manage.deadlineHint: The wish period is locked automatically afterwards.
manage.reopenHint: Choose a new deadline in the future to reopen.
manage.deadlinePast: The deadline must be in the future.
manage.allowEditHint: Employees can change submitted wishes until the deadline.
manage.createdOpen: Wish period opened – the team has been notified

editor.noUnits: You are not scheduling any ward right now.
editor.noScheduleHint: Create a draft. Employees only see it once it is published.
editor.publishedHint: This roster is published: every change is visible immediately and the person affected is notified.

editor.publishWithIssues_one: There is still {{count}} note. You can publish anyway.

people.inviteHint: The person receives an email and sets their own password.

people.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
people.roleScopeUnit: The role applies to the selected ward.
people.roleScopeHospital: Without a ward, the role applies to the whole hospital.
people.rolesHint: You can only hand out roles with administrative rights you hold yourself. You cannot give yourself additional rights.
people.deactivated: Deactivated – no more access to this hospital

shifts.hint: Changes apply to newly planned shifts. Shifts already planned keep their times.
shifts.overnightHint: The end is before the start – the shift ends the next day (e.g. night shift).

integration.title: Import roster
integration.subtitle: Bring the finished roster over from your rostering software
integration.dropTitle: Drop the file here or choose it
integration.dropHint: CSV or Excel (XLSX) from your rostering software – as a list (one row per shift) or a grid (one row per person, one column per day).
integration.privacyHint: The file is read on your device only. ShiftCare receives the recognised shifts; names and original rows are deleted after publishing.

errors.format: This format is not supported. Please export as CSV or XLSX.
errors.size: The file is larger than 15 MB.
errors.noProfile: There is no active import profile for this ward. Please contact your administration.
errors.empty: No rows were found in the file.
errors.unreadable: The file could not be read.

integration.layoutListHint: One row per shift with date and shift code (optionally start, end, break).
integration.layoutGridHint: One row per person; the columns are the days of the month, the cells contain the shift codes.

role.externalShiftId: Shift ID in the source system

integration.noDayColumns: No day columns found. The column headers must be days (e.g. “1”, “01.”, “01.11.”).

message.not_in_unit: not a member of this ward
message.off_and_shift: day off and shift on the same day – the shift counts

review.duplicate: This file was already imported for this ward and month. The preview shows whether anything changed.
review.employeesHint: ShiftCare does not know these IDs from the file yet. The match is saved and used automatically next time.
review.noNameMatching: Names are deliberately never matched automatically – only confirmed IDs or exact personnel numbers.
review.codesHint: Which shift type does the code from your rostering software stand for?
review.codesRemembered: Applies to all future imports of this ward.
review.otherErrorsHint: Please correct them in the rostering software and export the file again.

preview.title: Preview of the changes
preview.newRoster: There is no roster for this month yet – it is created as a draft.
preview.manual_one: {{count}} entry was created or changed by hand in ShiftCare and is replaced by the file.
preview.manual_other: {{count}} entries were created or changed by hand in ShiftCare and are replaced by the file.
preview.notifyHint: Affected staff receive one summary notification.
preview.applyFailedHint: Nothing was changed. Usually a shift overlaps with a shift on another ward. Please check and try again.
preview.superseded: A newer file for this month has been applied in the meantime. Please import the current file.
preview.notYetPublished: Not visible to the team yet. Check the roster in the editor or publish it right away.
preview.publishedHint: Everyone now sees their shifts in the app and has been notified.
preview.mostlyRemoved: Caution: {{count}} existing entries would be removed. The file counts as the complete roster of the ward for this month – is it really complete?

admin.intro: Define here from which rostering software wards import their roster. File import (CSV/XLSX) is available. Direct interfaces to individual vendors are not implemented yet – they are only offered once they have been built and tested.
admin.namePlaceholder: e.g. Export from the rostering software
admin.kindFileHint: Ward managers upload the finished roster as CSV or Excel.
admin.notImplemented: Not available yet: there is no adapter for this type, no data is fetched.
admin.vendorHint: Name of the program the export comes from (for information).
admin.secretHint: Stored encrypted in the Vault and not readable afterwards.
admin.secretStored: Credentials are stored. A new value replaces them.
admin.noMappings: None yet – personnel numbers are recognised directly.
admin.noCodeMappings: None yet – codes like F, S, N are recognised directly.
